post_title: Rent it by the year or by the month? Same house, two strategies.
caption:
Long-term or mid-term rental? Same house. 🏠

The strategy can matter as much as the property. Head to head:

• Rent: $2,200 vs $3,300 furnished. Mid-term wins.
• Cash to start: $70K vs $82K with furniture. Long-term wins.
• Monthly costs: $2,093 vs $3,082 with vacancy and utilities. Long-term wins.
• Cash flow: +$107 vs +$218 a month. Mid-term wins.
• Cash-on-cash: 1.8% vs 3.2%. Mid-term takes it, 3–2.

But furnished means more work. Check local demand before you buy.

Example numbers: $250K house, 25% down, 7% 30-year; mid-term with 15% vacancy, $300/mo utilities and $12K of furniture.
